rail_samples.method: mode RGB of the 5px rail column (x=171:176) on each desktop frame. Solid states sample pixels matching the state token; patterned states sample non-background rail pixels (never a mean over a patterned rail). DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY dashes are 10px on / 6px off (period 16px). STALE hatch is 3px on / 3px off at 135deg (vertical period 8.5px). Periods differ by ≥4px.
